## भाग-2 / PART 2 — FACTS

1. आवेदक जुलाई 2024 से प्रतिवादी प्रतिष्ठान **Shree Auto Components, Sector 3, Pithampur** में **Helper** के पद पर कार्यरत था/थी। नियोजन की शर्तें मौखिक/लिखित ([TO CONFIRM]) थीं तथा सहमत मासिक वेतन **₹12,000/-** (बारह हजार रुपये) था।

   *(The Applicant was employed as a Helper at the Respondent establishment — Shree Auto Components, Sector 3, Pithampur — since July 2024, on a monthly wage of ₹12,000/-.)*

2. प्रतिवादी नियोक्ता ने **जून 2026, जुलाई 2026 एवं अगस्त 2026** के वेतन-काल (wage periods) हेतु आवेदक को कोई वेतन अदा नहीं किया, जबकि उक्त प्रत्येक वेतन-काल की समाप्ति के 7वें/10वें दिन तक वेतन का भुगतान किया जाना अनिवार्य था।

   *(The Respondent failed to pay wages for the wage periods of June 2026, July 2026 and August 2026, totalling ₹36,000/-, despite the same being due and payable.)*

3. आवेदक का कारण-उद्भव दिनांक / Date of cause of action: **20 June 2026** (प्रथम अदत्त वेतन-काल की देय-तिथि / date on which wages first fell due).

4. दिनांक **13 September 2026** को प्रतिवादी नियोक्ता ने आवेदक को बिना किसी पूर्व लिखित सूचना (notice) के और बिना कारण बताये अचानक सेवामुक्त कर दिया। कोई समाप्ति-पत्र (termination letter) या राहत-पत्र (relieving letter) प्रदान नहीं किया गया।

   *(On 13 September 2026, the Respondent abruptly terminated the Applicant's services without any written notice, without assigning reasons, and without issuing a termination/relieving letter.)*

5. Payment of Wages Act 1936 की धारा 5 के अनुसार, सेवामुक्त कर्मकार का वेतन सेवा-समाप्ति की तिथि के दूसरे कार्य-दिवस तक अदा किया जाना अनिवार्य है। प्रतिवादी ने ऐसा नहीं किया।

   *(Under Section 5 of the Payment of Wages Act 1936, wages of a dismissed worker must be paid by the second working day after the employment ends. The Respondent has not complied.)*

6. **PF कटौती किन्तु जमा नहीं / PF Deducted But Not Deposited:** आवेदक के वेतन से प्रतिवादी द्वारा प्रोविडेंट फंड की कर्मकार-अंश राशि प्रत्येक माह काटी जाती थी, परन्तु उक्त राशि आवेदक के EPFO खाते/UAN खाते में जमा नहीं कराई गई। आवेदक का UAN नं.: **[TO CONFIRM]**। यह EPF & MP Act 1952 की धारा 14 के अन्तर्गत दण्डनीय अपराध है।

   *(The Respondent was deducting the employee's share of Provident Fund from the Applicant's wages each month but has not deposited the same in the Applicant's EPFO account. The UAN number is to be confirmed. This constitutes an offence under Section 14 of the EPF & MP Act 1952.)*

7. आवेदक ने प्रतिवादी को दिनांक [TO CONFIRM — date of demand letter, if sent] को पंजीकृत डाक द्वारा माँग-पत्र प्रेषित किया है, जिसकी प्रति संलग्न है। प्रतिवादी ने कोई उत्तर नहीं दिया / अब तक भुगतान नहीं किया।

---

## भाग-3 / PART 3 — LEGAL POSITION

| धारा / Section | अधिनियम / Act | प्रासंगिकता / Relevance |
|---|---|---|
| **PWA 5** | Payment of Wages Act 1936 | तीन माह का वेतन (₹36,000/-) वेतन-काल की समाप्ति के नियत दिन तक तथा सेवामुक्ति के दूसरे कार्य-दिवस तक न दिया जाना इस धारा का उल्लंघन है। |
| **PWA 15** | Payment of Wages Act 1936 | इस Authority के समक्ष आवेदन प्रस्तुत कर अदत्त वेतन की वसूली एवं क्षतिपूर्ति की माँग की जाती है। |
| **EPF 7A** | EPF & MP Act 1952 | PF अंशदान जमा न करने पर RPFC द्वारा जाँच व वसूली के आदेश हेतु प्रासंगिक। |
| **EPF 14** | EPF & MP Act 1952 | कर्मकार-अंश काटकर जमा न करना दण्डनीय अपराध है — EPFO को अलग से शिकायत की जाएगी। |
| **ID Act 25F** | Industrial Disputes Act 1947 | एक वर्ष की सतत सेवा के उपरान्त बिना नोटिस, नोटिस-वेतन या छँटनी-प्रतिकर के की गई सेवा-समाप्ति अवैध है — Labour Court के समक्ष अलग आवेदन (ID Act 2A के अन्तर्गत) दाखिल किया जाएगा। |
| **ID Act 2A** | Industrial Disputes Act 1947 | व्यक्तिगत कर्मकार की सेवा-समाप्ति स्वतः औद्योगिक विवाद है; कर्मकार सीधे Labour Court में आवेदन दे सकता है। |

---

## भाग-4 / PART 4 — RELIEF PRAYED FOR

आवेदक इस माननीय Authority से निम्नलिखित अनुतोष की विनम्र प्रार्थना करता/करती है:

1. प्रतिवादी को आदेशित किया जाए कि वह आवेदक को **₹36,000/-** (तीन माह का अदत्त वेतन @ ₹12,000/- प्रतिमाह, June 2026, July 2026 एवं August 2026 हेतु) का भुगतान करे।
2. Payment of Wages Act 1936 की धारा 15 के अन्तर्गत उचित **क्षतिपूर्ति (compensation)** प्रदान की जाए।
3. कोई अन्य अनुतोष जो इस माननीय Authority उचित समझे।

---

1. आवेदक का आधार कार्ड / Aadhaar card (ID proof)

3. वेतन पर्ची / Wage slips या बैंक स्टेटमेंट जिसमें वेतन-जमा दिख रहा हो / Bank statement showing salary credits (यदि उपलब्ध हो)
4. उपस्थिति का प्रमाण / Attendance record, muster roll entry या biometric log (यदि उपलब्ध हो)
5. सेवा-समाप्ति पत्र / Termination/Relieving letter — [TO CONFIRM; if not given, a written note of the date and manner of oral dismissal]
6. EPFO Member Passbook / UAN statement (PF जमा न होने का प्रमाण)
7. नियोक्ता को भेजा गया माँग-पत्र एवं उसका डाक/ई-मेल प्रमाण
8. कोई अन्य दस्तावेज — [TO CONFIRM]

Dear Sir/Madam,

I, [Worker's Full Name — TO CONFIRM], was employed as a **Helper** at your establishment, **Shree Auto Components, Sector 3, Pithampur**, from **July 2024** at a monthly wage of **₹12,000/- (Rupees Twelve Thousand only)**.

- Pay me the outstanding wages of **₹36,000/-** along with applicable compensation;
- Pay one month's wages in lieu of notice: **₹12,000/-**; and
- Deposit forthwith all outstanding EPF contributions (employee's and employer's share) in my EPFO/UAN account and furnish me with proof thereof.

- File a claim application before the **Authority under Section 15 of the Payment of Wages Act 1936 (Labour Court, Indore)** for recovery of ₹36,000/- plus compensation;

- Lodge a complaint with the **EPFO Regional Office, Indore/Bhopal (EPFiGMS portal: epfigms.gov.in)** under Sections 7A and 14 of the EPF & MP Act 1952 for non-deposit of PF contributions; and
- Pursue all other remedies available under law, including complaints to the Labour Commissioner, Madhya Pradesh.

This notice is issued without prejudice to all my rights and remedies.

Yours faithfully,

`____________________________`
[Worker's Full Name — TO CONFIRM]

2. प्रतिवादी नियोक्ता ने **जून 2026, जुलाई 2026 एवं अगस्त 2026** के वेतन-काल (wage periods) हेतु आवेदक को कोई वेतन अदा नहीं किया, जबकि उक्त प्रत्येक वेतन-काल की समाप्ति के 7वें/10वें दिन तक वेतन का भुगतान किया जाना अनिवार्य था।

   *(The Respondent failed to pay wages for the wage periods of June 2026, July 2026 and August 2026, totalling ₹36,000/-, despite the same being due and payable.)*

3. आवेदक का कारण-उद्भव दिनांक / Date of cause of action: **20 June 2026** (प्रथम अदत्त वेतन-काल की देय-तिथि / date on which wages first fell due).

4. दिनांक **13 September 2026** को प्रतिवादी नियोक्ता ने आवेदक को बिना किसी पूर्व लिखित सूचना (notice) के और बिना कारण बताये अचानक सेवामुक्त कर दिया। कोई समाप्ति-पत्र (termination letter) या राहत-पत्र (relieving letter) प्रदान नहीं किया गया।

   *(On 13 September 2026, the Respondent abruptly terminated the Applicant's services without any written notice, without assigning reasons, and without issuing a termination/relieving letter.)*

5. Payment of Wages Act 1936 की धारा 5 के अनुसार, सेवामुक्त कर्मकार का वेतन सेवा-समाप्ति की तिथि के दूसरे कार्य-दिवस तक अदा किया जाना अनिवार्य है। प्रतिवादी ने ऐसा नहीं किया।

   *(Under Section 5 of the Payment of Wages Act 1936, wages of a dismissed worker must be paid by the second working day after the employment ends. The Respondent has not complied.)*

6. **PF कटौती किन्तु जमा नहीं / PF Deducted But Not Deposited:** आवेदक के वेतन से प्रतिवादी द्वारा प्रोविडेंट फंड की कर्मकार-अंश राशि प्रत्येक माह काटी जाती थी, परन्तु उक्त राशि आवेदक के EPFO खाते/UAN खाते में जमा नहीं कराई गई। आवेदक का UAN नं.: **[TO CONFIRM]**। यह EPF & MP Act 1952 की धारा 14 के अन्तर्गत दण्डनीय अपराध है।

   *(The Respondent was deducting the employee's share of Provident Fund from the Applicant's wages each month but has not deposited the same in the Applicant's EPFO account. The UAN number is to be confirmed. This constitutes an offence under Section 14 of the EPF & MP Act 1952.)*

7. आवेदक ने प्रतिवादी को दिनांक [TO CONFIRM — date of demand letter, if sent] को पंजीकृत डाक द्वारा माँग-पत्र प्रेषित किया है, जिसकी प्रति संलग्न है। प्रतिवादी ने कोई उत्तर नहीं दिया / अब तक भुगतान नहीं किया।

## (पंजीकृत डाक A.D. / Registered Post A.D. — or Email with Read Receipt)

---

**दिनांक / Date:** 20 September 2026

**प्रेषक / From:**
[Worker's Full Name — TO CONFIRM]
S/o or D/o [TO CONFIRM]
[Residential Address — TO CONFIRM]

The Manager / Proprietor / Authorised Signatory
**Shree Auto Components**
Sector 3, Pithampur, District Dhar [TO CONFIRM PIN]

**Subject: Legal Demand Notice for Recovery of Unpaid Wages (₹36,000/-) and Notice Pay — before institution of proceedings under the Payment of Wages Act 1936 and the Industrial Disputes Act 1947**

---

Dear Sir/Madam,

I, [Worker's Full Name — TO CONFIRM], was employed as a **Helper** at your establishment, **Shree Auto Components, Sector 3, Pithampur**, from **July 2024** at a monthly wage of **₹12,000/- (Rupees Twelve Thousand only)**.

I write to bring the following breaches of law to your attention and to demand immediate rectification:

1. **Unpaid Wages — ₹36,000/-:** You have failed to pay my wages for the months of **June 2026, July 2026 and August 2026**, amounting to **₹36,000/-** in total. This is in violation of Section 5 of the Payment of Wages Act 1936, which requires payment within 7/10 days after the close of each wage period and, in the case of a dismissed worker, by the second working day after dismissal.

2. **Illegal Termination Without Notice:** On **13 September 2026**, you abruptly terminated my services without any written notice, without giving one month's notice or wages in lieu thereof, and without paying retrenchment compensation, in violation of Section 25F of the Industrial Disputes Act 1947. No termination or relieving letter was issued.

3. **PF Deducted But Not Deposited:** You have been deducting my share of Provident Fund (EPF) from my wages every month but have not deposited the said amount in my EPFO account. Deducting an employee's share and failing to deposit it is a criminal offence under Section 14 of the Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act 1952, punishable with imprisonment and fine.

**I hereby call upon you to, within 15 (fifteen) days of receipt of this notice:**

- Pay me the outstanding wages of **₹36,000/-** along with applicable compensation;
- Pay one month's wages in lieu of notice: **₹12,000/-**; and
- Deposit forthwith all outstanding EPF contributions (employee's and employer's share) in my EPFO/UAN account and furnish me with proof thereof.

**Failure to comply within 15 days will leave me with no option but to:**
- File a claim application before the **Authority under Section 15 of the Payment of Wages Act 1936 (Labour Court, Indore)** for recovery of ₹36,000/- plus compensation;
- File an application under **Section 2A of the Industrial Disputes Act 1947** before the Labour Court for reinstatement and/or back wages on account of the illegal termination;
- Lodge a complaint with the **EPFO Regional Office, Indore/Bhopal (EPFiGMS portal: epfigms.gov.in)** under Sections 7A and 14 of the EPF & MP Act 1952 for non-deposit of PF contributions; and
- Pursue all other remedies available under law, including complaints to the Labour Commissioner, Madhya Pradesh.

This notice is issued without prejudice to all my rights and remedies.

Yours faithfully,

`____________________________`
[Worker's Full Name — TO CONFIRM]

next_steps: STEP 1 — DEMAND LETTER (Today — 20 Sep 2026): Send the attached demand letter to Shree Auto Components by Registered Post A.D. (at the post office) and, if possible, also by email. Keep the postal receipt and the returned AD card safely; the Authority will ask for this.

STEP 2 — PF PASSBOOK (Urgent): Download the EPFO Member Passbook immediately from https://unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in using UAN and mobile OTP. If UAN is not known, check it at https://unifiedportal-mem.epfindia.gov.in/memberinterface/ using the Aadhaar/PAN/bank account. The passbook will show NIL credits even though PF was deducted — this is the key documentary proof. Note: deducting an employee's share of PF from wages and failing to deposit it is itself a criminal offence under Section 14 of the EPF & MP Act 1952.

STEP 3 — PF GRIEVANCE / EPFO COMPLAINT (Within 2 weeks): File an online grievance on the EPFiGMS portal (https://epfigms.gov.in) for 'Employer not depositing contribution'. Also approach the EPFO Regional Office at Indore or Bhopal in person. The Regional Provident Fund Commissioner can hold an inquiry under Section 7A and direct the employer to deposit arrears with damages and interest.

STEP 4 — PWA CLAIM APPLICATION (Within 15 days of demand letter going unheeded, and in any case before 20 June 2027 — the limitation date): Fill Form A under the MP Payment of Wages Rules 1962 and file it before the Authority under Section 15, Payment of Wages Act 1936 — Labour Court, Indore. A worker's application carries NO court fee. A registered trade union official or a Payment of Wages Inspector may also file the application on the worker's behalf.

STEP 5 — CONCILIATION FOR ILLEGAL TERMINATION (Within 45 days): To pursue the illegal termination claim under the Industrial Disputes Act 1947 (Sections 2A, 25F), the worker must first approach the Conciliation Officer (Labour Office, Pithampur / Indore). After 45 days from the date of the conciliation application (or on failure of conciliation), the worker may file a direct application to the Labour Court under Section 2A. The three-year limitation from 13 September 2026 applies to that claim.

STEP 6 — GATHER DOCUMENTS: Collect all documents listed in 'what_to_carry' before visiting the Labour Court or Labour Office. If the employer refuses to give wage slips or the attendance record, make a written request by Registered Post to the employer — refusal itself is relevant before the Authority.

STEP 7 — LABOUR COMMISSIONER PORTAL: The worker or the supervising advocate may also register the grievance on the MP Shram Seva portal at https://labour.mp.gov.in for administrative follow-up, but the formal legal claim must be filed before the Authority / Labour Court as above.

STEP 8 — SUPERVISING ADVOCATE'S REVIEW: This draft is for a supervising advocate's review only. Please verify: (a) the exact address and sitting schedule of the Labour Court / notified Authority at Indore; (b) all [TO CONFIRM] fields; (c) whether the establishment is covered under the Factories Act 1948 (which may trigger additional Inspector powers); (d) the worker's UAN; and (e) whether the Code on Wages 2019 has been brought into force in MP by the date of filing (currently not in force — cite PWA 1936).
